# Owl Lab

<p class="identity-line">Urban Climate · <span class="keep-together">Built Environment · People</span></p>
<p class="identity-line identity-line-en">气候 · 空间 · 人</p>

<p class="hero-statement">We try to disentangle the complex and continually changing relationships among climate, urban space, and people.</p>
:::

::: {.hero-note .academic-description}
Owl Lab studies how built environments interact with urban environmental processes under climate change, how these relationships shape human exposure, perception, and behavior, and how such knowledge can inform climate-responsive design and planning.
:::
:::
